Keep in mind Call Copilot is intentionally focused: it records meeting audio and
produces a clean local transcript — not a summarizer, calendar integrator, or
cloud product. Scope-expanding ideas are welcome but may be declined; see
CONTRIBUTING.md → "Project scope".
